tara: Drafted a short-form blog post for Redwood Optimize focusing on developer wins & cost controls. Need quick copy edits and confirm link destinations. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/3DEF. Target publish Apr 8. Primary CTA: webinar signup, secondary: private demo.
henry: Quick read 0% changes mostly grammar and tighten intro. Suggest starting with concrete dev pain: 'spiky token bills' then introduce Optimize. Add a TL;DR bullet list at top.
kai: SEO/CTA: add keywords "inference optimization", "batching and caching". HubSpot form id: 24680-optimize. Webhook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/sdr/optimize. UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=shortform_cta
sabrina: Legal check: no absolute promises, please use qualifiers. Also ensure we don't disclose internal cost numbers unless cleared. Provide benchmark appendix link but mark it internal.
tara: Edited intro and added TL;DR. Henry can you quick pass the new intro?
henry: Looks good. Also add OG tags and alt text for hero image.
ops-bot: Publish slot requested: Wed Apr 8 08:30 UTC. Draft status: awaiting final review.
tara: Thanks team. I'll queue this as a short-form variant for the launch series and schedule the webinar CTA. :slightly_smiling_face:
